items.title: Turkey-Shaped Bread Centerpiece
items.alt: A golden turkey-shaped bread loaf with a roll-feather tail stands on a board beside herb butter and cranberries.
items.description: Scored rolls fan behind the bread bird’s small head, red wattle and rounded wings, creating an edible centerpiece with a complete paddle-board outline.

items.title: Open-Faced Turkey and Cranberry Sandwiches
items.alt: Two open-faced turkey sandwiches with cranberry topping and lettuce share a wooden board with chips and gravy.
items.description: Thick bread slices support overlapping roast slices and glossy red berries, while the curved paddle handle balances the chip pile.

items.title: Roast Turkey with a Ring of Harvest Sides
items.alt: A roast turkey fills the center of a round platter ringed with corn, squash halves, rolls and herbs.
items.description: The overhead arrangement forms a compact circular feast, with the golden bird framed by alternating yellow, orange and green sides.

items.title: Turkey Dinner on a Blue Scalloped Plate
items.alt: Sliced roast turkey, mashed potatoes and green beans fill a blue scalloped plate beside cranberry sauce and a mustard napkin.
items.description: Silver cutlery rests on the folded napkin, and gravy follows the curved row of turkey slices opposite the green beans.

items.title: Turkey Feast on a Wooden Buffet Bench
items.alt: A wooden buffet bench displays roast turkey on a pedestal platter with salad, stuffing and a basket of rolls.
items.description: A cream runner with small leafy motifs crosses the timber top, while two carved supports and their full feet remain visible below.

items.title: Overhead Turkey Feast for Four
items.alt: A central turkey platter is surrounded by four served plates, vegetable bowls, rolls and small glasses of orange juice.
items.description: The circular meal arrangement pairs sliced turkey with potatoes, green beans and cranberry sauce, leaving clear gaps between the individual dishes.
